headline: Grade 4 Student's Can Drive Exceeds Goal for School Playground
meta_description: A Grade 4 student in La Ronge collected thousands of cans and bottles over the summer, raising $2,300 for a new school playground.
summary_short: A determined Grade 4 boy in La Ronge spent his summer collecting cans and bottles, gathering between 9,000 and 23,000 containers to fund a playground upgrade.
body:
A Grade 4 student in La Ronge set out this summer with an ambitious goal: raise $1,000 for a new school playground. What he accomplished far exceeded expectations.

Collecting between 9,000 and 23,000 cans and bottles over the season, the young fundraiser handed over $2,300—more than double his original target. The sheer volume of containers he gathered speaks to both his determination and the community support he received.

His effort transforms a simple fundraising idea into something tangible: the promise of a better playground for his classmates. The money now sits ready to bring that vision to life, thanks to one student's summer of collecting.
